terrain.mode.paint.tooltip: Paints ground textures with the brush instead of shaping the ground
paint.title: Ground textures
paint.hint: Choose a texture and paint where it should show. A texture painted later covers the ones before it; the first one is the ground the whole map starts as.
paint.mode.paint.tooltip: Lays the chosen texture on and takes textures painted over it away under the brush
paint.mode.erase.tooltip: Takes the chosen texture away, so the one beneath shows
paint.mode.soften.tooltip: Blurs the edge of the chosen texture for a soft transition
paint.hardness.tooltip: How much of the brush's radius paints fully; the rest fades out into a soft transition
paint.cover.tooltip: Covers the tile under the pointer with the chosen texture
paint.clear.tooltip: Takes the chosen texture off the tile under the pointer
paint.add.tooltip: Adds a texture from the OMSI installation's Texture folder to this map
paint.status.failed: The ground could not be painted: {reason}
